settings.title: System Settings
settings.desc: Customize operating parameters and individual configurations for each tool module.
settings.language_setting_desc: Choose the default display language for the application.

home_title.label: Homepage Title
home_title.placeholder: Title displayed at the top of the homepage

image_to_prompt.title: Image to Prompt
image_to_prompt.desc: Configuration for reverse engineering images to AI prompts via Ollama Vision.

default_model.label: Default Ollama Model
default_model.help_text: Vision model name on Ollama (e.g. qween3.8, qwen2.5-vl, llava).

default_language.label: Default Prompt Language
default_language.help_text: Language code for generated prompts (e.g., en for English, vi for Vietnamese).

timeout_seconds.label: Max Timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.help_text: Timeout for Ollama to process each image (default: 1200s = 20 mins).

system_prompt.label: Prompt Extraction Instructions (System Prompt)
system_prompt.help_text: Instructions for the AI model. Use {output_language} to automatically insert target language.

system_prompt.label: Translation System Prompt
system_prompt.help_text: Prompt sent to Ollama. Use {target_language} to automatically insert target language.

pdf_to_md.title: PDF to Markdown
pdf_to_md.desc: Configuration for converting PDF to Markdown (supports text, figures, and OCR).

pages_per_file.label: Pages per Markdown file
pages_per_file.help_text: Each .md file will contain up to this many pages (1 to 500). Longer PDFs will split into multiple files/zip.

extract_images.label: Extract illustrations (true / false)
extract_images.help_text: Extract figures, charts, and drawings and embed them into markdown.

image_embed_mode.label: Image saving mode (folder / base64)
image_embed_mode.help_text: folder: zip archive containing images/ folder; base64: embed directly as base64 in .md file.

ocr_mode.label: OCR mode for scanned pages (auto / gemini / ollama / off)
ocr_mode.help_text: auto: automatic fallback; gemini: use Google Gemini; ollama: use local vision model; off: disable OCR.

gemini_api_key.label: Gemini API Key (Optional for AI OCR)
gemini_api_key.help_text: Free Gemini API key from Google AI Studio for high-accuracy OCR on scanned pages.

ollama_model.label: Ollama Vision Model Name
ollama_model.help_text: Multimodal model on Ollama (e.g. llama3.2-vision, llava, minicpm-v).

image_compressor.title: Image Compressor
image_compressor.desc: Default settings for Image Compressor (quality percentage and backup folder).

default_quality.label: Default compression quality % (1 - 100)
default_quality.help_text: Integer from 1 to 100. Default is 20% (high compression, maximum space savings).

backup_folder_name.label: Original image backup folder name
backup_folder_name.help_text: Subfolder name automatically created to store original images during folder batch compression (default: backup).
